     | The ACRIS Real Property Master dataset includes document level details for deed, mortgages and other real property related documents recorded in ACRIS against properties in the four boroughs of Manhattan, Bronx, Brooklyn and Queens. In addtional the dataset also includes index details for stand-alone NYC and NYS transfer tax returns submitted to ACRIS (like returns related to the sale of cooperative shares) and NYC transfer tax returns submitted to the Richmond County Clerk.

Documents in this dataset are uniquely identified by both the document id and CRFN fields; however to find the most current version of the index data for the document, one must find the record with the most recent good through date. The good through date roughly corresponds to when a specific version of index data for a document was published in OpenData.

Most document will only have one good through date and for many documents that good through date corresponds to the initial date ACRIS data was published in OpenData; however some documents may have more than one.

After documents are recorded, they are included in the next monthly OpenData update with a good through date corresponding to the month of recording. If the index data for a document is subsequently updated in another month, all index data for the document is re-published to OpenData with a new good through date corresponding to the month of correction.
